product.name: Personal Training with Future Coaches
product.description: A personalized fitness coaching service pairing users with certified coaches who create customized workout plans and provide ongoing support via a mobile app.

product.name: Customized Workout Programs
product.description: Tailored exercise plans developed by coaches to meet users' specific fitness goals, preferences, and constraints.

product.name: Fitness Progress Tracking and Assessments
product.description: A system for recording and monitoring users' exercise performance and progress through regular fitness assessments.

product.name: Workout Tutorials and Form Feedback
product.description: Instructional content and a feature allowing users to record and receive coach feedback on exercise form.

product.name: Health and Wellness Discounts
product.description: Access to exclusive discounts on supplements, sleep aids, and recovery accessories for users.
